candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u} {G : Type v} [inst : Field.{u} k] [inst_1 : Group.{v} G] [inst_2 : Fintype.{v} G]
  [inst_3 : Invertible.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Fintype.card.{v} G))] (V W : FDRep.{u, v} k G),
  Eq.{u + 1}
    (HSMul.hSMul.{u, u, u} (Invertible.invOf.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Fintype.card.{v} G)))
      (Finset.sum.{v, u} Finset.univ.{v} fun g =>
        HMul.hMul.{u, u, u} (FDRep.character.{u, v} V g) (FDRep.character.{u, v} W (Inv.inv.{v} g))))
    (Nat.cast.{u} (Module.finrank.{u, u} k (Quiver.Hom.{u, max (u + 1) v} W V)))

∀ {G : Type u} [inst : Group.{u} G] [inst_1 : Fintype.{u} G] {k : Type u} [inst_2 : Field.{u} k]
  [inst_3 : IsAlgClosed.{u} k] [inst_4 : NeZero.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Nat.card.{u} G))] (D : IrrepDecomp.{u, u} k G)
  (V : Fin (IrrepDecomp.n.{u, u} D) → FDRep.{u, u} k G),
  (∀ (i : Fin (IrrepDecomp.n.{u, u} D)), CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, u + 1} (V i)) →
    (∀ (i j : Fin (IrrepDecomp.n.{u, u} D)),
        Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} (V i) (V j)) → Eq.{1} i j) →
      (∀ (W : FDRep.{u, u} k G),
          CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, u + 1} W →
            Exists.{1} fun i => Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} W (V i))) →
        ∀ (g h : G),
          Eq.{u + 1}
            (Finset.sum.{0, u} Finset.univ.{0} fun i =>
              HMul.hMul.{u, u, u} (FDRep.character.{u, u} (V i) g) (FDRep.character.{u, u} (V i) (Inv.inv.{u} h)))
            (ite.{u + 1} (IsConj.{u} g h)
              (Nat.cast.{u}
                (Fintype.card.{u}
                  (Subtype.{u + 1} fun x =>
                    Membership.mem.{u, u} (Subgroup.centralizer.{u} (Singleton.singleton.{u, u} g)) x)))
              0)
